title: Unpaid cluster ceiling runbook
body: When an unpaid cluster approaches the daily dollar ceiling, DENY sms.send and LIMIT llm.call to a small model. Keep paying users failing open for login. Shadow new rules for 24h before enforce.

title: Ghost spend kill-switch runbook
body: If vendor usage minus app ledger exceeds threshold: disable the key, alert on Slack/WhatsApp, open investigator card, propose wiring PR to remove client-side keys. Reversible when owner rotates credentials.

title: OTP country mismatch rule
body: For new unpaid accounts, if phone country differs from IP country, DENY otp. Backtest on 30 days of events; enforce only if false-positive rate is under 0.5%.

title: Server-side key wiring
body: Move openai/gemini calls into a server or edge function. App calls BleedStop decide first, then the function uses a secret env key. Client must never see the vendor key.
